name: Types of reactions precipitation and displacement

questions.q: What is a precipitation reaction?
a: A reaction where mixing two soluble salt solutions produces an insoluble solid product (precipitate)
A reaction where rain falls outdoors
A reaction where a gas bubbles out of solution
A reaction where metals melt into liquids

questions.q: What term describes the solid product that settles out of solution during a precipitation reaction?
What is a displacement reaction?
a: A reaction where two liquids swap colors
A reaction where gases expand in volume
A reaction where a more reactive element displaces a less reactive element from a compound
A reaction where solids turn into gases

questions.q: What happens when a piece of zinc metal is placed into a solution of copper(II) sulfate?
a: Zinc sinks and turns into gold
Copper metal dissolves into a gas
Zinc displaces copper, depositing brown copper metal and forming colorless zinc sulfate solution

questions.q: Why will copper metal *not* react with a solution of zinc sulfate?
a: Copper is less reactive than zinc, so it cannot displace zinc from its compound

questions.q: Which of the following is an example of a precipitation reaction when mixing two solutions?
a: Mixing aqueous silver nitrate with aqueous sodium chloride to form insoluble silver chloride
Melting ice cubes in a beaker

questions.q: In the reactivity series of metals, how does reactivity generally change as you move down the group of alkali metals or down column trends?
What is observed visually when aqueous lead(II) nitrate is mixed with aqueous potassium iodide?
a: A bright yellow precipitate of lead(II) iodide instantly forms

questions.q: What is the role of solubility rules in chemistry?
a: To predict whether a specific ionic salt is soluble or insoluble in water, helping identify precipitates
To determine the boiling point of gases

questions.q: Which of the following metal displacement reactions will take place spontaneously?
a: Silver metal added to copper(II) sulfate solution
Magnesium metal added to copper(II) sulfate solution
Copper metal added to iron(II) sulfate solution
Gold metal added to zinc sulfate solution

questions.q: What term is used to describe ions that do not change or participate in a precipitation reaction?
When chlorine gas is bubbled into a solution of potassium bromide, what type of reaction occurs and what is observed?
a: Thermal decomposition; bubbles of steam appear
Halogen displacement; the solution turns orange-brown as bromine is displaced

questions.q: Why does a displacement reaction occur between a reactive metal and a metal salt solution?
a: The more reactive metal has a greater tendency to lose electrons and form positive ions than the less reactive metal
Heat is absorbed from the air

questions.q: Which of the following compounds is generally *insoluble* in water according to standard solubility rules?
What is formed during the thermite reaction, which is a dramatic displacement reaction between aluminum powder and iron(III) oxide?
a: Molten iron metal and aluminum oxide

questions.q: In an ionic equation for a precipitation reaction, what does the inclusion of states like (aq) and (s) highlight?
a: That soluble ions react to form an insoluble solid precipitate (s)

questions.q: If you mix barium chloride solution with dilute sulfuric acid, what insoluble white precipitate is formed?
Why can carbon be used in blast furnaces to displace iron from iron oxide ores?
a: Carbon is more reactive than iron and can reduce iron oxides by taking away oxygen

questions.q: What happens to the color of a copper(II) sulfate solution when a strip of magnesium ribbon is placed in it?
a: The blue color fades as copper ions are removed from solution and copper metal coats the magnesium

questions.q: Which of the following halogen displacement reactions will *not* occur?
What experimental technique is used to separate an insoluble precipitate from the liquid mixture after a precipitation reaction?
When sodium hydroxide solution is added to copper(II) sulfate solution, what colored precipitate forms?
a: Light blue precipitate of copper(II) hydroxide

questions.q: How can you experimentally determine the order of reactivity of three unknown metals using displacement reactions?
a: Test each metal in salt solutions of the other two metals to see which ones cause displacement
